additions.group: 地震波形・自己教師あり専門表現
additions.reason_selected: Independent contrastively pretrained seismic waveform encoder, not another generic time-series forecasting model or a quantization. Three-component ground-motion representation for low-label downstream geophysics. Preserve compact Base only; Large does not justify marginal bytes without matched evidence. No existing selected model establishes same-task replacement.
additions.quality_positive: Publisher 11,359,568 FP32 parameters including original pretraining heads; 6-layer Wav2Vec2-derived transformer hidden 240, 3 ZNE channels, 100 Hz, 3001 samples -> 749 x 240 features. Original eight-corpus pretraining (ETHZ/GEOFON/STEAD/MLAAPDE/InstanceCounts/Iquique/PNW/OBST2024); paper reports low-label downstream transfer. Publisher synthetic 8-field regression exact on CPU and NVIDIA GB10 with Python 3.12.3/PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130; not independent performance or hardware latency.
additions.quality_negative: Bare encoder lacks trained phase/event head; no earthquake-warning efficacy established. No automatic resampling or missing-channel filling; training optimizer omitted, dataset snapshots/rights and exact recreation unresolved. SeisMoLLM reports SeisLM deficiencies; later objective-comparison preprint reports downstream tradeoffs. Independent matched transfer, memory/clock/batch and runtime ABI unverified; wheel code unreviewed.
additions.risk_and_alternative_assessment: Scientific ground-motion research only; validation required for safety-critical decisions. KEEP forecast, satellite and imaging incumbents. No harmful-capability ranking.
additions.observed_access: public ungated observed 2026-11-28; owner permission unverified
additions.license_metadata: MIT publisher LICENSE and explicit author weight grant; owner acts, training data and wheel dependencies unresolved
